blurb: Guests explore historic streets and local landmarks in Portland, then splash into Casco Bay on a modern amphibious vehicle. The tour is fully narrated and suitable for all ages. Seating is first-come, first-served, and tours operate rain or shine with covered vehicles.

quotes.author: fumiko2021
quotes.text: We did it as a part of our Portland trip with small kids aged 3-7. We all enjoyed the tour of the city as well as the boat time as well. Dugan was very helpful in getting us oriented after the ride as well. Highly recommend this!

quotes.author: ojerio
quotes.text: What a fun tour, we enjoyed our trip on land and water. Truly, it quacked us up! I would recommend this tour on the beginning of your stay in Portland, it will give you a nice overview of the area.

quotes.author: PeterQ784
quotes.text: Dugan and Captain Mike did an excellent job. Both were very professional. Dugan was a great host, he was very knowledgeable and friendly-I would highly recommend this tour if you are in Portland.

quotes.author: elizarivas2020
quotes.text: The Maine Duck Tours is a good way to oversee the city. You get taken on land and water so it is entertaining and fun!
